sources.name: National Highway Planning Network
sources.use: Network topology and route-family backbone only
sources.limitations: Nominal 1:100,000 source scale; horizontal error can reach approximately 80 meters. Never treat as final lane geometry.

sources.name: National Highway System (NHS)
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of Transportation, Federal Highway Administration (via BTS NTAD)
sources.use: Supplementary corridor centerlines and state-LRS milepoints where NHPN keys carry no records; NHPN remains the route-family backbone (ADR-0026)
sources.limitations: NHS extent only; per-state geometry vintage and density vary (record fields YEAR, VERSION, UPDATE_DAT). Redistribution must retain the source metadata entry per the dataset's own license text. Not lane geometry.

sources.name: National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP)
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of Agriculture, FPAC Geospatial Enterprise Operations
sources.use: Break-adjudication ground truth only: dated, checksummed quads evidencing physical road continuity for ADR-0018 correction records (ADR-0026). Not a geometry source.
sources.limitations: 2-3 year state acquisition cycles; record quad ID, flight date, resolution, and SHA-256 per acquired tile.

sources.name: 3D Elevation Program
sources.limitations: Record the exact product URL, publication date, and checksum for each acquired raster.
